scheme_name: Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must have passed Class 4th (relaxable for deserving cases)
Applicant must be a member of the Tribal Community notified by the Government of Goa
Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution
Applicant must have been a permanent resident of Goa for at least 15 years
Compulsory entrepreneurship training of up to 7 days within six months from sanction
Eligible activities are Micro and Small Manufacturing Enterprises, Service Enterprises, and Trade Enterprises
Non‑eligible activities include farming activities, tobacco products, and red‑category industries
benefits_summary: Provides a 40% subsidy on loan (up to 95% of project cost) with a 4% interest rate and up to 7 days compulsory entrepreneurship training.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
